ticket.subject: No reset email
ticket.body_text:
Good morning,

I look after our account at Wrenfield Partners. I requested a password reset four times this morning, but the email never arrives.

I can still use the mobile app because I am signed in there, so I am not completely stuck.

This is blocking us right now, so we need help today. Please send a reset link or reset it from your side.

Yours sincerely,
Sofia Brandt
engineering manager, Wrenfield Partners
